input.plan:
# Combat HUD Layout Polish

## Scope
Implement the four visual tweaks in the runtime HUD builder so behavior remains responsive across resolutions.

## Files To Change
- [`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd)
- [`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md`](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md)

## Implementation Plan
1. **Align items panel bottom to execute line**
   - In `_apply_responsive_layout()`, stop sizing side columns to full main-band height.
   - Compute a shared `side_panel_height` that ends at the same vertical line as the execute button band (using existing layout constants and footer margin), then apply it to both `_item_picker_panel` and `_spin_history_panel`.
   - Keep this purely constant-driven so it scales with viewport size.

2. **Move total bankroll closer to stake indicator**
   - Adjust top HUD vertical anchors by tuning `LAYOUT_CENTER_HUD_Y0` and `LAYOUT_CENTER_HUD_Y1` so `CenterTopHud` sits lower.
   - Keep `bankroll_label` font/readout logic unchanged; only shift placement.

3. **Restore rectangle for spin history section**
   - Update `_build_history_placeholder()` to use a `PanelContainer` wrapper with `_side_panel_style()` (or equivalent darker variant) instead of bare `Control` placeholder-only content.
   - Preserve current `HistoryHeader` + placeholder list structure, but ensure bordered panel visuals match the items side panel.

4. **Make HISTORY/ITEMS titles larger and darker-backed**
   - Increase `SIDE_PANEL_HEADER_FONT` to a larger value.
   - Add a darker title background treatment (header-level stylebox or dedicated title strip container) used consistently by both `_make_side_panel()` (items) and `_build_history_placeholder()` (history).
   - Keep text alignment and semantic labels intact (`HISTORY`, `ITEMS (x/y)`).

5. **Governance + documentation update**
   - Append an implementation note to [`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md`](C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/plans/core/AI_CHANGELOG.md) describing these UI layout/style updates.

## Validation
- Launch `res://combat/combat_test.tscn` and verify:
  - Items panel bottom aligns with execute button line.
  - Bankroll readout is visibly closer to stake row.
  - History section has a visible bordered rectangle again.
  - HISTORY and ITEMS headers are larger and visibly darker-backed.
- Resize window to confirm responsive layout keeps relative alignment stable.

func _build_history_placeholder() -> Control:
	var root := VBoxContainer.new()
	root.name = "HistoryPanel"
	root.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
	root.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	root.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)

	var header := Label.new()
	header.name = "HistoryHeader"
	header.text = "HISTORY"
	header.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	header.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", SIDE_PANEL_HEADER_FONT)
	header.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.75, 0.35, 0.35, 0.95))
	root.add_child(header)

	var placeholder := Control.new()
	placeholder.name = "HistoryPlaceholder"
	placeholder.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	placeholder.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	placeholder.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
	root.add_child(placeholder)

	root.set_meta("header", header)
	root.set_meta("list", placeholder)
	return root

func _side_panel_style() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(0.07, 0.0, 0.0, 0.88)
	style.border_color = Color(0.45, 0.03, 0.03, 0.75)
	style.set_border_width_all(2)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(4)
	style.content_margin_left = 8
	style.content_margin_top = 8
	style.content_margin_right = 8
	style.content_margin_bottom = 8
	return style


func _make_side_panel(header_text: String) -> PanelContainer:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	panel.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
	panel.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _side_panel_style())

	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	panel.add_child(vbox)

	var header := Label.new()
	header.text = header_text
	header.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	header.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", SIDE_PANEL_HEADER_FONT)
	header.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.75, 0.35, 0.35, 0.95))
	vbox.add_child(header)

	var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
	vbox.add_child(scroll)

	var list := VBoxContainer.new()
	list.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	list.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	scroll.add_child(list)

	panel.set_meta("header", header)
	panel.set_meta("scroll", scroll)
	panel.set_meta("list", list)
	return panel

func _side_panel_style() -> StyleBoxFlat:

func _side_panel_title_style() -> StyleBoxFlat:
	var style := StyleBoxFlat.new()
	style.bg_color = Color(0.03, 0.0, 0.0, 0.98)
	style.border_color = Color(0.35, 0.02, 0.02, 0.85)
	style.set_border_width_all(1)
	style.set_corner_radius_all(2)
	style.content_margin_left = 8
	style.content_margin_top = 6
	style.content_margin_right = 8
	style.content_margin_bottom = 6
	return style


func _style_side_panel_header(header: Label) -> void:
	header.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	header.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", SIDE_PANEL_HEADER_FONT)
	header.add_theme_color_override("font_color", Color(0.88, 0.4, 0.4, 1.0))


func _make_side_panel_header_strip(header_text: String) -> PanelContainer:
	var strip := PanelContainer.new()
	strip.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _side_panel_title_style())
	var header := Label.new()
	header.name = "SectionHeader"
	header.text = header_text
	_style_side_panel_header(header)
	strip.add_child(header)
	return strip


func _make_side_panel(header_text: String, with_scroll_list: bool = true) -> PanelContainer:
	var panel := PanelContainer.new()
	panel.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
	panel.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_SHRINK_BEGIN
	panel.add_theme_stylebox_override("panel", _side_panel_style())

	var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
	panel.add_child(vbox)

	var header_strip := _make_side_panel_header_strip(header_text)
	vbox.add_child(header_strip)
	var header := header_strip.get_child(0) as Label

	if with_scroll_list:
		var scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
		scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		scroll.horizontal_scroll_mode = ScrollContainer.SCROLL_MODE_DISABLED
		vbox.add_child(scroll)

		var list := VBoxContainer.new()
		list.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 4)
		list.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		scroll.add_child(list)

		panel.set_meta("scroll", scroll)
		panel.set_meta("list", list)
	else:
		var placeholder := Control.new()
		placeholder.name = "HistoryPlaceholder"
		placeholder.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		placeholder.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		placeholder.mouse_filter = Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE
		vbox.add_child(placeholder)
		panel.set_meta("list", placeholder)

	panel.set_meta("header", header)
	return panel
